# Generated by tools/generate_council_assignment.py. Edit the generator.
# The 32-state DP is exact across all eligible courtiers and direct vassals.
# It never assigns a character twice and never dismisses a protected incumbent.

caa_schedule_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            is_alive = yes
            is_ai = no
            has_variable = caa_enabled
            NOT = { has_variable = caa_tick_pending }
        }
        set_variable = { name = caa_tick_pending value = yes }
        trigger_event = { id = caa.0001 days = 30 }
    }
}

caa_toggle_enabled_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = caa_enabled }
        remove_variable = caa_enabled
        # Keep pending until its event drains: rapid off/on cannot create duplicates.
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { caa_supported_ruler_trigger = yes }
        set_variable = { name = caa_enabled value = yes }
        caa_run_assignment_effect = yes
        caa_schedule_effect = yes
    }
}

caa_toggle_powerful_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = caa_prioritize_powerful }
        remove_variable = caa_prioritize_powerful
    }
    else = { set_variable = { name = caa_prioritize_powerful value = yes } }
    caa_run_assignment_effect = yes
}

caa_toggle_observer_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = caa_observer }
        remove_variable = caa_observer
    }
    else = { set_variable = { name = caa_observer value = yes } }
    caa_run_assignment_effect = yes
}

caa_prepare_seats_effect = {
	cp:councillor_chancellor ?= { scope:caa_owner = { set_variable = { name = caa_old_0 value = prev } } }
	if = {
	    limit = {
	        exists = council_task:councillor_chancellor
	        OR = {
	            NOT = { exists = cp:councillor_chancellor }
	            AND = {
	                cp:councillor_chancellor = { can_be_fired_from_council_trigger = { COURT_OWNER = scope:caa_owner } }
	                OR = {
	                    has_variable = caa_observer
	                    AND = {
	                        has_variable = caa_prioritize_powerful
	                        cp:councillor_chancellor = { is_powerful_vassal_of = scope:caa_owner }
	                    }
	                }
	            }
	        }
	    }
	    set_variable = { name = caa_open_0 value = yes }
	}
	cp:councillor_steward ?= { scope:caa_owner = { set_variable = { name = caa_old_1 value = prev } } }
	if = {
	    limit = {
	        exists = council_task:councillor_steward

	            NOT = { exists = cp:councillor_steward }
	            AND = {

	                        cp:councillor_steward = { is_powerful_vassal_of = scope:caa_owner }
	                    }
	                }
	            }
	        }

caa_score_candidate_effect = {
	save_scope_as = caa_candidate
	scope:caa_owner = {
		set_variable = { name = caa_candidate_keep value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = caa_candidate_power value = 0 }
	    if = {
	        limit = {
	            NOT = { has_variable = caa_observer }
	            scope:caa_candidate = { is_councillor_of = scope:caa_owner }
	        }
	        set_variable = { name = caa_candidate_keep value = 1 }
	    }
	    if = {
	        limit = {
	            has_variable = caa_prioritize_powerful
	            scope:caa_candidate = { is_powerful_vassal_of = scope:caa_owner }
	        }
	        set_variable = { name = caa_candidate_power value = 1 }
	    }
	    remove_variable = caa_candidate_score_0
	    if = {
	        limit = { scope:caa_candidate = { caa_candidate_for_chancellor_trigger = yes } }
	        set_variable = { name = caa_candidate_score_0 value = scope:caa_candidate.caa_chancellor_score_value }
	    }
	    remove_variable = caa_candidate_score_1
	    if = {
	        limit = { scope:caa_candidate = { caa_candidate_for_steward_trigger = yes } }
	        set_variable = { name = caa_candidate_score_1 value = scope:caa_candidate.caa_steward_score_value }
	    }
	    remove_variable = caa_candidate_score_2
	    if = {
	        limit = { scope:caa_candidate = { caa_candidate_for_marshal_trigger = yes } }
	        set_variable = { name = caa_candidate_score_2 value = scope:caa_candidate.caa_marshal_score_value }
	    }
	    remove_variable = caa_candidate_score_3
	    if = {
	        limit = { scope:caa_candidate = { caa_candidate_for_spymaster_trigger = yes } }
	        set_variable = { name = caa_candidate_score_3 value = scope:caa_candidate.caa_spymaster_score_value }
	    }
	    remove_variable = caa_candidate_score_4
	    if = {
	        limit = { scope:caa_candidate = { caa_candidate_for_court_chaplain_trigger = yes } }
	        set_variable = { name = caa_candidate_score_4 value = scope:caa_candidate.caa_court_chaplain_score_value }
	    }
	    caa_dp_candidate_effect = yes
	}
}

caa_select_best_effect = {
	set_variable = { name = caa_best_keep value = -1 }
	set_variable = { name = caa_best_fill value = -1 }
	set_variable = { name = caa_best_power value = -1 }
	set_variable = { name = caa_best_score value = -1 }
	if = {
	    limit = {
	        has_variable = caa_dp_0_score
			OR = {
				AND = {
					var:caa_dp_0_keep > var:caa_best_keep
				}
				AND = {
					var:caa_dp_0_keep = var:caa_best_keep
					var:caa_best_fill < 0
				}
				AND = {
					var:caa_dp_0_keep = var:caa_best_keep
					var:caa_best_fill = 0
					var:caa_dp_0_power > var:caa_best_power
				}
				AND = {
					var:caa_dp_0_keep = var:caa_best_keep
					var:caa_best_fill = 0
					var:caa_dp_0_power = var:caa_best_power
					var:caa_dp_0_score > var:caa_best_score
				}
			}
	    }
		set_variable = { name = caa_best_keep value = var:caa_dp_0_keep }
		set_variable = { name = caa_best_fill value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = caa_best_power value = var:caa_dp_0_power }
		set_variable = { name = caa_best_score value = var:caa_dp_0_score }
		remove_variable = caa_best_0
		remove_variable = caa_best_1
		remove_variable = caa_best_2
		remove_variable = caa_best_3
		remove_variable = caa_best_4
	}
	if = {
	    limit = {
	        has_variable = caa_dp_1_score
			OR = {
				AND = {
					var:caa_dp_1_keep > var:caa_best_keep
				}
				AND = {
					var:caa_dp_1_keep = var:caa_best_keep
					var:caa_best_fill < 1
				}
				AND = {
					var:caa_dp_1_keep = var:caa_best_keep
					var:caa_best_fill = 1
					var:caa_dp_1_power > var:caa_best_power
				}
				AND = {
					var:caa_dp_1_keep = var:caa_best_keep
					var:caa_best_fill = 1
					var:caa_dp_1_power = var:caa_best_power
					var:caa_dp_1_score > var:caa_best_score
				}
			}
	    }
		set_variable = { name = caa_best_keep value = var:caa_dp_1_keep }
		set_variable = { name = caa_best_fill value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = caa_best_power value = var:caa_dp_1_power }
		set_variable = { name = caa_best_score value = var:caa_dp_1_score }
		set_variable = { name = caa_best_0 value = var:caa_dp_1_seat_0 }
		remove_variable = caa_best_1
		remove_variable = caa_best_2
		remove_variable = caa_best_3
		remove_variable = caa_best_4
	}
	if = {
	    limit = {
	        has_variable = caa_dp_2_score
			OR = {
				AND = {
					var:caa_dp_2_keep > var:caa_best_keep
				}
				AND = {
					var:caa_dp_2_keep = var:caa_best_keep
					var:caa_best_fill < 1
				}
				AND = {
					var:caa_dp_2_keep = var:caa_best_keep
					var:caa_best_fill = 1
					var:caa_dp_2_power > var:caa_best_power

	    }

		set_variable = { name = caa_best_fill value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = caa_best_power value = var:caa_dp_2_power }
		set_variable = { name = caa_best_score value = var:caa_dp_2_score }
		remove_variable = caa_best_0

		remove_variable = caa_best_2

		remove_variable = caa_best_4

caa_apply_best_effect = {
	if = {
	    limit = {
	        has_variable = caa_open_0
	        has_variable = caa_old_0
	    }
	    if = {
	        # Put the optional (possibly unfilled) destination on the LEFT.
	        # CK3 does not suppress an unset right-hand scope inside an OR.
	        limit = { NOT = { var:caa_best_0 ?= var:caa_old_0 } }
	    if = {
	        limit = { var:caa_old_0 = { OR = {
				scope:caa_owner.var:caa_best_0 ?= this
				scope:caa_owner.var:caa_best_1 ?= this
				scope:caa_owner.var:caa_best_2 ?= this
				scope:caa_owner.var:caa_best_3 ?= this
				scope:caa_owner.var:caa_best_4 ?= this
	        } } }
	        # Retained councillors are moving roles, not being dismissed.
	        fire_councillor_skip_effects = var:caa_old_0
	    }
	    else = { fire_councillor = var:caa_old_0 }
	    }
	}
	if = {
	    limit = {
	        has_variable = caa_open_1
	        has_variable = caa_old_1
	    }
	    if = {
	        # Put the optional (possibly unfilled) destination on the LEFT.
	        # CK3 does not suppress an unset right-hand scope inside an OR.
	        limit = { NOT = { var:caa_best_1 ?= var:caa_old_1 } }
	    if = {
	        limit = { var:caa_old_1 = { OR = {
				scope:caa_owner.var:caa_best_0 ?= this
				scope:caa_owner.var:caa_best_1 ?= this
				scope:caa_owner.var:caa_best_2 ?= this
				scope:caa_owner.var:caa_best_3 ?= this
				scope:caa_owner.var:caa_best_4 ?= this
	        } } }
	        # Retained councillors are moving roles, not being dismissed.
	        fire_councillor_skip_effects = var:caa_old_1
	    }
	    else = { fire_councillor = var:caa_old_1 }
	    }
	}
	if = {
	    limit = {
	        has_variable = caa_open_2
	        has_variable = caa_old_2
	    }
	    if = {
	        # Put the optional (possibly unfilled) destination on the LEFT.
	        # CK3 does not suppress an unset right-hand scope inside an OR.
	        limit = { NOT = { var:caa_best_2 ?= var:caa_old_2 } }
	    if = {
	        limit = { var:caa_old_2 = { OR = {
				scope:caa_owner.var:caa_best_0 ?= this
				scope:caa_owner.var:caa_best_1 ?= this
				scope:caa_owner.var:caa_best_2 ?= this
				scope:caa_owner.var:caa_best_3 ?= this
				scope:caa_owner.var:caa_best_4 ?= this
	        } } }
	        # Retained councillors are moving roles, not being dismissed.
	        fire_councillor_skip_effects = var:caa_old_2
	    }
	    else = { fire_councillor = var:caa_old_2 }
	    }
	}
	if = {
	    limit = {
	        has_variable = caa_open_3
	        has_variable = caa_old_3
	    }
	    if = {
	        # Put the optional (possibly unfilled) destination on the LEFT.
	        # CK3 does not suppress an unset right-hand scope inside an OR.
	        limit = { NOT = { var:caa_best_3 ?= var:caa_old_3 } }
	    if = {
	        limit = { var:caa_old_3 = { OR = {
				scope:caa_owner.var:caa_best_0 ?= this
				scope:caa_owner.var:caa_best_1 ?= this
				scope:caa_owner.var:caa_best_2 ?= this
				scope:caa_owner.var:caa_best_3 ?= this
				scope:caa_owner.var:caa_best_4 ?= this
	        } } }
	        # Retained councillors are moving roles, not being dismissed.
	        fire_councillor_skip_effects = var:caa_old_3
	    }
	    else = { fire_councillor = var:caa_old_3 }
	    }
	}
	if = {
	    limit = {
	        has_variable = caa_open_4
	        has_variable = caa_old_4
	    }
	    if = {
	        # Put the optional (possibly unfilled) destination on the LEFT.
	        # CK3 does not suppress an unset right-hand scope inside an OR.
	        limit = { NOT = { var:caa_best_4 ?= var:caa_old_4 } }
	    if = {
	        limit = { var:caa_old_4 = { OR = {
				scope:caa_owner.var:caa_best_0 ?= this
				scope:caa_owner.var:caa_best_1 ?= this
				scope:caa_owner.var:caa_best_2 ?= this
				scope:caa_owner.var:caa_best_3 ?= this
				scope:caa_owner.var:caa_best_4 ?= this
	        } } }
	        # Retained councillors are moving roles, not being dismissed.
	        fire_councillor_skip_effects = var:caa_old_4
	    }
	    else = { fire_councillor = var:caa_old_4 }
	    }
	}
	if = {
	    limit = { has_variable = caa_best_0 }
	    if = {
	    limit = {
	        NOT = { cp:councillor_chancellor ?= var:caa_best_0 }
	        var:caa_best_0 = { valid_for_council_position = councillor_chancellor }
	    }
	    assign_councillor_type = { type = councillor_chancellor target = var:caa_best_0 }
	    }
	}
	if = {
	    limit = { has_variable = caa_best_1 }
	    if = {
	    limit = {
	        NOT = { cp:councillor_steward ?= var:caa_best_1 }
	        var:caa_best_1 = { valid_for_council_position = councillor_steward }
	    }
	    assign_councillor_type = { type = councillor_steward target = var:caa_best_1 }
	    }
	}
	if = {
	    limit = { has_variable = caa_best_2 }
	    if = {
	    limit = {
	        NOT = { cp:councillor_marshal ?= var:caa_best_2 }
	        var:caa_best_2 = { valid_for_council_position = councillor_marshal }
	    }
	    assign_councillor_type = { type = councillor_marshal target = var:caa_best_2 }
	    }
	}
	if = {
	    limit = { has_variable = caa_best_3 }
	    if = {
	    limit = {
	        NOT = { cp:councillor_spymaster ?= var:caa_best_3 }
	        var:caa_best_3 = { valid_for_council_position = councillor_spymaster }
	    }
	    assign_councillor_type = { type = councillor_spymaster target = var:caa_best_3 }
	    }
	}
	if = {
	    limit = { has_variable = caa_best_4 }
	    if = {
	    limit = {
	        NOT = { cp:councillor_court_chaplain ?= var:caa_best_4 }
	        var:caa_best_4 = { valid_for_council_position = councillor_court_chaplain }
	    }
	    assign_councillor_type = { type = councillor_court_chaplain target = var:caa_best_4 }
	    }
	}

caa_run_assignment_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = caa_enabled
            caa_supported_ruler_trigger = yes
        }
        save_scope_as = caa_owner
        caa_clear_scratch_effect = yes
        caa_prepare_seats_effect = yes
        set_variable = { name = caa_dp_0_keep value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = caa_dp_0_power value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = caa_dp_0_score value = 0 }
        every_courtier = {
            limit = { caa_candidate_pool_trigger = yes }
            add_to_list = caa_candidates
        }
        every_vassal = {
            limit = {
                caa_candidate_pool_trigger = yes
                NOT = { is_in_list = caa_candidates }
            }
            add_to_list = caa_candidates
        }
        every_in_list = {
            list = caa_candidates
            caa_score_candidate_effect = yes
        }
        caa_select_best_effect = yes
        caa_apply_best_effect = yes
        caa_clear_scratch_effect = yes
        every_in_list = { list = caa_candidates remove_from_list = caa_candidates }
    }
}

caa_inherit_settings_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:previous_player_character }
        if = {
            limit = { scope:previous_player_character = { has_variable = caa_enabled } }
            set_variable = { name = caa_enabled value = yes }
        }
        else = { remove_variable = caa_enabled }
        if = {
            limit = { scope:previous_player_character = { has_variable = caa_prioritize_powerful } }
            set_variable = { name = caa_prioritize_powerful value = yes }
        }
        else = { remove_variable = caa_prioritize_powerful }
        if = {
            limit = { scope:previous_player_character = { has_variable = caa_observer } }
            set_variable = { name = caa_observer value = yes }
        }
        else = { remove_variable = caa_observer }
    }
    caa_run_assignment_effect = yes
    caa_schedule_effect = yes
}
